newsitem.title: PERU: Peru radio says six ministers offer to resign.
newsitem.headline: Peru radio says six ministers offer to resign.

text.p: Peruvian radio said Friday six ministers presented a letter of resignation to President Alberto Fujimori giving him the opportunity to remove them from his government, or give them other ministerial posts.

National radio station CPN said it learned from off- the-record comments that the ministers offered their resignations earlier Friday at a four-hour cabinet meeting, whose main theme had been changes in government positions.
Officials at Government Palace said they could not confirm the report.

"As far as I know the (cabinet meeting) did not deal with the matter of resignations," said palace spokesman Ysrael Mertz, adding a communique would be issued later Friday outlining what had been discussed at the cabinet meeting.
Fujimori's cabinet now has one vacant post following Fisheries Minister Carlos Boggiano's resignation last month due to health reasons.
Citing unnamed sources, leading newspaper El Comercio reported earlier this week that Fujimori was planning to reshuffle in his cabinet.
